## ADW Review Report — feat-11: Prevent Duplicate Fragment Title on Clone

### Executive Summary

The implementation is complete and fully spec-compliant. All four required files were modified: `generateUniqueTitle` in `utils.js` exactly matches the spec pseudocode; `#generateUniqueFragmentTitle` and the `copyFragment` update in `mas-repository.js` implement the deduplication flow as specified; unit tests in both test files cover all required scenarios. All four files pass `node --check`. Two minor test-quality issues were found — neither is a blocker. No hardcoded secrets, no debug statements, no TODO/FIXME markers.

---

### Issues by Severity

#### Tech Debt

**Issue 1 — Private method stub silently no-ops**
- **File**: `studio/test/mas-repository.test.js`, line 1519 (`buildRepository`)
- **Description**: `sandbox.stub(repository, '_MasRepository__addToCache').resolves(...)` uses Python-style name mangling, which does not apply to JavaScript `#`-prefixed private fields. The stub silently has no effect; `#addToCache` will execute in the test environment. The try/catch swallowing all errors prevents this from causing false positives, but the isolation intent is not achieved.
- **Recommended fix**: Remove the stub and rely on the catch block to handle downstream `#addToCache` failures, or redesign the test to use a factory/DI seam.

**Issue 2 — Conditional assertion pattern reduces test clarity**
- **File**: `studio/test/mas-repository.test.js`, line 1545
- **Description**: `if (saveCall.called) { expect(...) } else { expect.fail(...) }` should be `expect(saveCall.called).to.be.true; const savedFragment = saveCall.firstCall.args[0]; expect(savedFragment.title).to.equal('lucy-card-1');`. The conditional form is semantically correct but less readable and may obscure intent in CI output.
- **Recommended fix**: Assert `saveCall.called` unconditionally before reading `firstCall.args[0]`.

#### Skippable

**Issue 3 — Misleading test description for suffix-gap case**
- **File**: `studio/test/utils.test.js`, line 30
- **Description**: Test is titled "starts from root+1 when only title-3 exists (not title-1)" but actually passes `'lucy-card'` (no suffix) as `baseTitle`. The description implies the base has a suffix of 3. The inline comment inside the test body corrects for this. Minor clarity issue only.
- **Recommended fix**: Rename to `"returns title-1 when gap exists between title and title-3"` and remove the corrective inline comment.

---

### Plan Compliance

| Acceptance Criterion | Status |
|---|---|
| Cloning existing title → clone gets `{original}-1` | ✅ `generateUniqueTitle` + `copyFragment` wiring verified |
| Cloning again → `{original}-2`, etc. | ✅ While loop increments until unique |
| Cloning unique title → title unchanged | ✅ Early return `if (!existingTitles.has(baseTitle))` |
| Original card title never modified | ✅ Only `result.title` (copy) is mutated; `this.fragmentInEdit.title` untouched |
| Manual edits respected and deduplicated | ✅ `intendedTitle = updatedTitle?.trim() \|\| this.fragmentInEdit.title` |
| All existing tests continue to pass | ✅ `node --check` passes all 4 files; no syntax errors |

---

### Screenshot Validation Log

No screenshots captured — dev server not reachable on port 9214 (connection refused). The feature changes are in repository logic (`copyFragment`) triggered only by AEM API calls; the clone dialog UI itself is unchanged.

---

### Verdict: **PASS**

No blocker issues. Two tech-debt items in test structure, one skippable naming issue.
